title: Travel Requests
emptyOversight: No travel requests from your team yet.

detail.noTimeline: This request has not been submitted for approval.
detail.plannedAmountHint: A category with a policy rate fills its own amount in. Leave the amount blank, or keep the figure it filled in, to let the policy price it — a per-diem for the destination, or a daily cap across the trip. Typing over it needs a note.
detail.plannedSearchAfterCreateFlight: Search for flights once the request is created — the fare is quoted against the trip and saved onto this line.
detail.plannedSearchAfterCreateStay: Search for hotels once the request is created — the rate is quoted against the trip and saved onto this line.
detail.varianceNone: Nothing has been filed against this trip yet.
detail.warnCarUnpriced: This trip includes a rental car. No travel provider we can reach quotes car hire, so the rental will not appear in the budget unless you add it as a planned item.
detail.warnNoBudget: Nothing has been priced for this trip yet, so the approver would see a total of zero. You can still submit it — but recalculating the per diem, fetching live prices or adding a planned item first will give them something to decide on.

quote.no-plan: Live pricing is off — the SerpApi integration is not installed.
quote.no-airports: No airports could be found for this route, so flights could not be priced.
quote.no-results: No flights or stays were found for these dates.
quote.past-date: The departure date has already passed, so nothing can be priced. Update the dates to see live prices.
quote.provider-error: Live prices could not be fetched. Your budget is unchanged — enter the amounts by hand, or try again later.
quote.provider-KEY_REJECTED: The travel-pricing provider rejected our credentials, so nothing could be priced. An administrator needs to check the SerpApi key.
quote.provider-PLAN_EXHAUSTED: The travel-pricing plan has no searches left this cycle, so nothing could be priced. Enter the amounts by hand until it resets.
quote.provider-BAD_REQUEST: The travel-pricing provider rejected this search. That is a fault on our side, not something you can fix — please report it.
quote.provider-UNKNOWN: Live prices could not be fetched. Your budget is unchanged — enter the amounts by hand, or try again later.

errors.roundTripNeedsReturn: A round trip needs a return date.
errors.returnBeforeDepart: The return date is before the departure date.

line.dailyCapHint: The policy ceiling per day. The line is priced at this × the days.
line.noLiveRate: No live rate available — priced from the policy cap.
line.overrideHint: An amount you type replaces the derived one permanently. To go back to the derived figure, add a new line in the same category and delete this one.
line.notesPlaceholder: Why this is needed — and on a flight, why this fare…

summary.perDiem: {days, plural, one {Per diem · # day} other {Per diem · # days}} · {city}

line.noteRequiredForOverride: Say why you are overriding the policy amount

picker.applyCap: Only show stays within the per-diem cap
picker.costHint: Each search uses a paid provider credit.

attendees.heading: Who is going
attendees.name: Name
attendees.none: Nobody added yet. A meal with no attendees is priced at nothing.

header.editHint: Changing the dates or the destination does not re-price the lines already here — each shows the amount it was created with.

policy.blockHint: This must be changed before the request can be submitted — it cannot be explained away.
policy.blockedSummary: {count, plural, one {# blocking policy violation must be fixed before this can be submitted.} other {# blocking policy violations must be fixed before this can be submitted.}}
policy.warnSummary: {count, plural, one {# warning needs an explanation before this can be submitted.} other {# warnings need an explanation before this can be submitted.}}
